skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts and principles of labor and human resources
Analyze the structure and distribution of human resources, the relationship between population and human resources
Apply quantitative techniques to analyze data on human resource economics
Apply qualitative techniques to analyze data on human resource economics
Solve problems related to labor market and social security
Work effectively in groups, demonstrate communication, presentation, analysis, synthesis, and problem-solving skills
Show the ability to self-study and research, choose topics, methods, and present research results
Analyze and evaluate policies related to social security and unemployment
Formulate ethical and professional responsibilities, adapt to different work environments
